description:
ChatStore::set_pinned_messages() validates each message ID against the DB with a separate SELECT EXISTS query in a loop (chat.rs lines 609-623). For M pins this is M round-trips before the transaction even opens.

For the common case (few pins, single-user mailbox) this is harmless. However the fix is trivial and makes the code obviously correct: replace the loop with a single query that counts messages matching the given IDs in the given chat, then compare the count to the input slice length. Any discrepancy means an invalid ID was supplied.

Example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE id IN (?,?,?) AND chat_id = ? — if result != pin_count, one of the IDs is bad.
title: set_pinned_messages validates message IDs with N sequential queries
